senses.gloss: m. (טרפס, Pales of טְרַף) debt matured for collection by seizure; שקל למ׳ to get one’s due, to be punished.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 57b:1">Pes. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>בריך רחמנא דאשקליה ליששכר … למִיטַּרְפְּסֵיה מיניה וכ׳</he> blessed be the Lord who caused Issachar … to receive his due at his (the king’s) hand in this world; (Ms. M. <he>דשַׁקְּלֵיה ליש׳ … למטרופסא</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 469:39">Yalk. Lev. 469</cite> <he>דשקליה יששכר למיטרפסיה</he>, read: <he>ליששכר</he>); <cite ref="Keritot 28b">Ker. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>דשקליה ליש׳ למטרפסיה</he>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 105b:8">Yeb. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>שָׁקְלֵיה רבי למטרפסיה</he> Rabbi received his due (it served him right).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 21a:16">Snh. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>שְׁקלְתֵּה מיכל למִיטַּרְפְּסָהּ</he> Michal received her due.
